idea: Ship broadcast identity in physically incompatible places
reason: Two products can reuse one AIS feed. Raw timestamp/position provenance, identifier reassignment and track interpolation must be excluded before identity deception is a distinct supported test. A sanctions label does not repair this gap.
review_basis: bounded model-authored follow-on screen; catalog and prior mechanism comparison only; no new documents or records

idea: Duplicate aircraft identity in simultaneous flight tracks
reason: Registration is not broadcast identity, ownership is not operation, and decoded tracks are not independent observations. No raw-message schema or physically constrained observation was established in this pass.
review_basis: bounded model-authored follow-on screen; catalog and prior mechanism comparison only; no new documents or records

idea: Same resource pledged to incompatible creditors
reason: Project/borrower overlap cannot establish the collateral, priority, exclusivity or operative amendment. Requires two actual executed financing/security instruments and asset schedule; current catalog fields do not provide those facts.
review_basis: bounded model-authored follow-on screen; catalog and prior mechanism comparison only; no new documents or records

idea: Arms delivery exceeds public sales approval
reason: DSCA notification is a possible sale, not necessarily the final export authorization or delivered quantity. SIPRI and UNROCA cover differing stages/categories; a notification-to-delivery count is not a defensible authorization breach.
review_basis: bounded model-authored follow-on screen; catalog and prior mechanism comparison only; no new documents or records

idea: Patent omits government rights despite research grant
reason: Patent funding acknowledgement and award match are only entry points. Subject-invention status, exact funding instrument, operative law, invention timing and title-election/disclosure records are needed. Public-funded-to-patent overlap was already covered; no additional verified obligation established here.
review_basis: bounded model-authored follow-on screen; catalog and prior mechanism comparison only; no new documents or records

idea: Payments in two lobbying systems are inconsistent
reason: LDA estimates and FARA principal-level receipts/disbursements have different scope and accounting windows. Difference alone is not a missing-money test; specific contradictory declarations and traceable ad items are already developed in X04/X06.
review_basis: bounded model-authored follow-on screen; catalog and prior mechanism comparison only; no new documents or records
